text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While eating in the cafeteria,
I overheard a conversation between a trio who seemed in the middle of a study session.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Shall we begin our test prep, then?
Presumptuous as it may be, I have full confidence in instructing classical Japanese literature.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Getting a failing grade is completely unacceptable for the Disciplinary Committee Chair!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I take too long on reading comprehension questions and am terrible at them... I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now then. First, let us read the original text, and I will pose questions based upon it.
Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ready whenever! Let's blast out correct answers one after another!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mm. Let's aim for a high score.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem*. Let us read.
From "The Tale of the Heike", Minamoto no Yorimasa's extermination of the Nue...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "—To begin with, the novice monk of the Third Rank, Gensanmi, was fifth generation from Settsu no Kami Yorimitsu, and grandson of Mikawa no Kami Yoritsuna..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "What was deemed the greatest renown of this man's life—...from among the warriors of both the Genji and Heike clans—...it is said he was chosen out—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me. Indeed, let us start with a simple modern translation first.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "—Long ago, a youkai known as a 'Nue' terrorized society night after night."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "The reigning Emperor ordered a warrior named Yorimasa to slay it. At this time, the secret plan Yorimasa devised to defeat the Nue was—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I've got it.
He lured it out with food and defeated it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
............
Incorrect.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately so. To begin with, the point is not to guess future developments.
And in the first place, I have not even asked the—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Aah?! I got it!
Yes! Pick me!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead.
You say you understand?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Surely...
He didn't actually defeat it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yorimasa and the Nue clashed head-on! Fair and square, flesh against flesh, they fought each other with everything they had!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Fighting on through morning and evening, before they knew it, what sprouted between the two of them was...
a strange friendship!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And so the two of them vowed to train, meet again, and fight once more... and went their separate ways!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: After that, Yorimasa spent his days battling youkai... But at last, he found himself surrounded by the Youkai Heavenly Kings! A total desperate pinch!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Just then! Tearing through the dark clouds, a single shadow appeared! Its true identity was—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I told you before... The one to strike you down is me!"
Yes! It was the Nue!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Guh, so hot-blooded!!
Yesterday's enemy is today's friend, the kind of friendship born in the heat of battle!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The Tale of the Heike is apparently a battle story packed with samurai, right?!
I bet that's totally how it goes!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I'm moved. Amazing, Bamboo.
To have such insight into the story...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Fwahaha... I'm starting to feel confident!
I might just score a perfect 100 on the next test!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—I must offer my utmost respect for your storytelling talent, Bamboo-san.
However—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, The Tale of the Heike is not that kind of story...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed countless hardships awaited their test preparation...
